items.title: Report from the Committee of the Whole – August 14, 2023
Report from the Committee of the Whole – August 14, 2023
Municipal Industrial Land Pricing for 2023
notes: Report from G. Borovilos, Manager of Economic Development George Borovilos, Manager of Economic Development provided an overview of the report and responded to questions regarding protection of environmentally sensitive lands within the business park, zoning measures to streamline the planning process, and the proposed target audience.
Colin Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure Services responded to questions regarding road design and construction to connect Dickson Drive to First Line.

items.title: Holding Zone Removal - 94 Wellington Road 7 (Phase 1), Elora
notes: Report from M. Iglesias, Manager of Planning Services
M. Iglesias, Manager of Planning Services provided an overview of the report including an explanation of a holding zone in a zoning by-law.

items.title: Municipal Class Environmental Assessment Study for the Union Street
notes: Sewage Pumping Station Expansion - Notice of Study Commencement Report from R. Maiden, Water and Wastewater Capital Project Manager Adam Gilmore, Manager of Engineering provided an overview of the report, indicating the purpose of the report is to notify Council and project stakeholders of the formal start of the Municipal Class Environmental Assessment through the issuance of a Notice of Commencement. He indicated the Township is seeking to identify a preferred alternative for increasing the capacity of the Union Street sewage pumping station.
A. Gilmore responded to questions regarding funding sources.

motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approve the report from the Committee of the Whole dated August 14, 2023 as circulated.
